Product Details: GROZ Dial Comparator Stand is intended to mount a dial indicator (not included) and measure external diameter, thickness, height, step etc. of a workpiece with high precision. It consists of a sturdy cast iron base precisely ground and machined providing a totally flat surface. The anvil is hardened 55-58 HRC for greater wear resistance and lapped for high accuracy setting of jobs. It is equipped with fine adjustment feature, leading to accurate setting of jobs in no time.
